title: No-Cook Peach Sorbet
changes_from_base: Raw ripe peaches with their skins, blended straight with sugar, replace the mango; less lime and no cooked syrup.
summary: Ripe peaches blended raw with their skins on give a blush-coloured sorbet that tastes exactly like summer fruit.

ingredients.item: ripe peaches (fresh or frozen), stoned and diced, skins left on
light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Blend the peaches, skins and all, with the sugar, corn syrup and lime juice until there are no lumps left, 1-2 min.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Push the purée through the sieve into the jug; you should have about 1 litre. Discard the skins.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add the salt, stir and taste; a pinch more brings out the peach.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Press baking paper onto the surface and refrigerate for 2-3 h, until very cold.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, pack into the container and freeze for 2-3 h, until firm.

tips: Leave the skins on; they add colour and flavour and are sieved out later.
Frozen peach slices work very well out of season.
Taste the purée cold; flavours are muted when frozen, so it should taste slightly too sweet.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
